name: Heeding the Call
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Mathrengyl Bearwalker has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch Druid himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in Teldrassil.

He is located in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am glad you found your way here today. young Champion. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 10, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Heeding the Call
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.objectiveText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade.

quests.name: Great Bear Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.

quests.name: Back to Darnassus
quests.objectiveText: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.

quests.name: Body and Heart
quests.objectiveText: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw.
